description: Updates an existing node in a Cognigy.AI flow. MUTATING: This modifies the node. Use dryRun=true (default) to validate first. Only provided fields are updated; others remain unchanged.

config.description: Node-specific configuration to update. Structure depends on node type. Only provided fields are updated.

dryRun.description: If true (default), validates the operation without updating. Set to false to actually update.

flowId.description: The flow ID containing the node

isDisabled.description: Whether the node is disabled (skipped during execution)

label.description: New display label for the node

localeId.description: Locale ID if updating locale-specific content

nodeId.description: The ID of the node to update

name: update_node
